findings.finding: c2 states round 1's replay scope consistently in all four places. R10 replays every helper vector and every vector, and of the complete positive v1's five checks plus the sealed-namespace equality. Profile v2's validate and precondition stay harness-side, so R10 needs neither profile.schema.json nor proxy_profile_v2. In substance this holds: by AST, the vector rows and those six checks never reach proxy_profile_v2 or the schema. But section 11 tells HE-004-I01B4 to port the v2 model, and the stated replay is not that model's check_vectors. The unchanged model (README header items 4, 5 and 7) calls _frozen(files) at line 1257, which pins scripts/proxy_profile_v2.py's bytes. It calls _profile_schema(files) at line 1258. Both run before the first helper vector (line 1266). _check_complete then runs validate and precondition as its checks 7 and 8. Run without the schema, check_vectors refuses before any row with 'frozen input differs: architecture/proxy-profile-v2/profile.schema.json' (I ran it). None of the four places says that R10's port omits the profile-schema load and profile v2's validate and precondition. None gives the count such a port reaches: 321, against the 323 stated for the model. So 'every vector … needs neither' holds only for a port the text does not define (MON-I01S-CR2-GO).

As under v1, it also leaves out the frozen-model file pins (_frozen's FROZEN_MODELS loop, scripts/proxy_profile_v2.py included), since models are pinned, not copied. As c2 did for round 1, c3's status line names c3, and status.json and source-index.json gain round 2, with the r2 rulings as the monitor rules.

questions: Q-CB2-1: I agree with (a), as built and kept (MON-I01S-CB2-1). Round 1's C1-1 named section 11's 'replays this contract's vectors' as part of the gap, so the scope belongs in section 11. The added sentence is long, but it reads in order: the scope, the harness-side checks and why, then the new-decision clause. Recommendation: keep it, and add C2-1's port wording to it or as a second sentence.

Q-CB2-2: I agree with (a) (MON-I01S-CB2-2). Each id quotes the line that carries its content. The head line names all four refs and is quoted once, under MON-I01S-CR1-KEEP. Every quote occurs exactly once in OWNER_DECISIONS.md, inside round 1's ruling section. Recommendation: keep it, and quote the r2 rulings in c3 the same way.

Q-CB2-3: I agree with (a) (MON-I01S-CB2-3). The entry pins the record and the identity by sha256, and the record carries its own subject. A subjectCommit for a never-pushed scratch commit would publish a commit id no reader can resolve. Recommendation: keep (a), for round 2 as well.

Q-CB2-4: I agree with (a) (MON-I01S-CB2-4). The table restates the rows, so it must follow the row's sha256 and byte count; I checked the prefix 6d70377e746d and 60,055 bytes. Recommendation: keep it, and regenerate the table from c3's README.

Q-CB2-5: I agree with (a) (MON-I01S-CB2-5). VPC defines validate_profile(profile, schema) (by AST, in the subject's copy). The README already defines VPC, and README-v11 and notes[3] spell out the schema they mean. Recommendation: keep it.

MON-I01S-CR2-GO's replay-scope point: I agree with the monitor, judged on my own against the model's text. check_vectors runs _frozen and _profile_schema before any row. I ran it without the schema, and it refused before the first helper vector. So 'R10 replays every helper vector and every vector … needs neither profile.schema.json nor proxy_profile_v2' holds only for a port that omits the profile-schema load and profile v2's validate and precondition. c2 states the outcome ('needs neither') in all four places, but nowhere states that omission. The stated scope is executable once the omission is said, because the rows and the six named checks never reach the schema or proxy_profile_v2. A reader also needs the count the port should reach, 321, since 323 is the only count stated. I rate this a MINOR (C2-1), not a NOTE. The contract is R10's specification for the port, and it leaves undefined where the port departs from the model it names. Recommendation: C2-1's wording in a c3, then a delta round 3 limited to it.
